english.title: Goods vehicle - make false statement to obtain operator's licence etc

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: GOODS VEHICLES LICENSING OF OPERATORS ACT 1995

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly made a false statement for the purpose of obtaining the issue to yourself or another of

(A)_[an operator's licence]_
(B)_[a certificate of qualification under Section 49 of the Goods Vehicles (Licensing of Operators) Act 1995]_
(C)_[a certificate or diploma such as is mentioned in Paragraph 13(1) of Schedule 3 to the Goods Vehicles (Licensing of Operators) Act 1995]_

in that **(..SPECIFY PARTICULARS OF THE FALSE STATEMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 39(1) and (2) of the Goods Vehicles (Licensing of Operators) Act 1995.

english.notes:

(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
